Grievance-v0.1.description: File a grievance against a government scheme and check where it stands. One scheme per payload, named by scheme.code. Each scheme defines one flat schema per call it serves and nothing else, so a new scheme or a new call is an addition and never an edit. Per-call shapes, worked examples and the reasoning behind every constraint are in README.md.

SchemeApplication-v0.1.name: SchemeApplication
SchemeApplication-v0.1.description: Read where a farmer's application to a government scheme stands: how many instalments have been paid, whether eKYC is done, and what is holding the money up. One scheme per payload, named by scheme.code. Each scheme defines one flat schema per call it serves and nothing else, so a new scheme or a new call is an addition and never an edit. This pack stands alone: it borrows nothing from another capability. Per-call shapes, worked examples and the reasoning behind every constraint are in README.md.
